primitive.relation: nat equality: the four unordered counts (chromatic XE1, X76, X78 over M1 aliases of sg_edge_set; D2ram over E(G)) convert to edge_count; the three enum-rank oriented pair selectors (X5, X4, D2tur through base oedge) equal it by GTBase.common.edge_count_rank, unconditionally.

unordered-edge-set.note: #|E(G)|, or #|xNN_edge_set G| over the M1 alias xNN_edge_set G = sg_edge_set G; equal by conversion; canonical GTBase.common.edge_count

rank-oriented-pairs.note: #|[set p : G * G | (p.1 -- p.2) && (enum_rank p.1 < enum_rank p.2)%N]| (D2tur through base oedge); one orientation per edge; bridge GTBase.common.edge_count_rank

public-doubleton-comprehension.note: #|fg_edges G| over [set e | exists x y, (x != y) && (x -- y) && (e == [set x; y])]; the explicit x != y guard is implied by irreflexivity, so fg_edges G = E(G) (fg_edgesE, a proved set equality) and the count is edge_count; bridges GTBase.finite_graph.fg_edgesE and card_fg_edges

upstream_audit.note: Upstream has the edge set E(G) = sg_edge_set with card_edge_Kn and diso_card_edge but no named count; the plan (section 15 table) places edge_count in GTBase.common over E(G). No upstream bridge for the enum-rank oriented selector exists; edge_count_rank is new (finite bijection p |-> [set p.1; p.2]). base.v oedge stays where it is: common.v does not import base.v. The public base count GTBase.finite_graph.fg_edge_count is the same quantity; it is an enrolled repository source of this family (fg_edgesE: fg_edges G = E(G)).
